detail.body:
## Purpose

Wires `relu2` (non-gated, `MoEActivation.RELU2_NO_MUL`) support into vLLM's ROCm AITER fused-MoE backend, so NemotronH-style models (which use a non-gated MLP activation via `activation_without_mul()`) can dispatch through `AiterExperts` instead of falling back to a slower/incompatible path.

This is Tier 3 of a larger effort: Tier 1 added the relu2 activation kernel, Tier 2 added CK-Tile fused MoE GEMM support for relu2 in [ROCm/aiter#5708](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/5708). This PR is the vLLM-side integration that lets `AiterExperts` actually route relu2 MoE layers into that aiter kernel.

**Dependency:** requires CK-Tile relu2 MoE GEMM support, which already  available in the [AITER v0.1.26](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/releases/tag/v0.1.26) version. 

## Test Plan

**Correctness / Accuracy:**
- GSM8K (0-shot or 5-shot, matching the model's standard eval config) on a NemotronH checkpoint

**Performance — TTFT / TPOT / throughput:**
- Benchmark via `vllm bench serve` (or the repo's standard serving benchmark script), sweeping:
  - Input/output length pairs: **1k/1k** and **8k/1k** (prefill-heavy vs. decode-heavy shapes)
  - Concurrency levels: e.g. 1, 8, 32, 64, 128
- Metrics to capture per (ISL/OSL, concurrency) cell:
  - TTFT (mean/p50/p99)
  - TPOT (mean/p50/p99)
  - Total throughput (tokens/s)
- Compare against:
  - Pre-PR baseline 



**Environment:**
- Hardware: MI300X and/or MI35X (matching aiter CI's Standard Tests matrix)

## Test Result

**Verification that AITER's Relu2 CK-Tile path is actually exercised (not silently falling back):**

Server log during real inference shows aiter's fused_moe dispatch actively resolving Relu2 configs:

​```
[aiter] [fused_moe] using 2stage default for ('gfx950', 256, 1024, 2048, 768, 512, 22, <ActivationType.Relu2: 5>, 'torch.bfloat16', 'torch.bfloat16', 'torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2', 'QuantType.per_1x32', False, False)
[aiter] run_1stage = False, xbf16 = False, ksplit = 0 q_type = QuantType.per_1x32 block_m = 128 use_nt = True, estimated_m_per_expert = 44
​```

### GSM8K Test Results

Model: `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16`
Quantization: `mxfp4`, Tensor Parallel Size: 8
Eval: `lm_eval`, GSM8K, 5-shot, num_concurrent=32

#### Baseline (VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0)

|Tasks|Version|Filter|n-shot|Metric|Value|Stderr|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|gsm8k|3|flexible-extract|5|exact_match|0.9348|0.0068|
|gsm8k|3|strict-match|5|exact_match|0.9295|0.0071|

#### With PR (VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1, VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1)

|Tasks|Version|Filter|n-shot|Metric|Value|Stderr|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|gsm8k|3|flexible-extract|5|exact_match|0.9348|0.0068|
|gsm8k|3|strict-match|5|exact_match|0.9318|0.0069|

#### Comparison

|Metric|Baseline|With PR|Diff|Within 1 stderr?|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|flexible-extract exact_match|0.9348 ± 0.0068|0.9348 ± 0.0068|0.0000|Yes (identical)|
|strict-match exact_match|0.9295 ± 0.0071|0.9318 ± 0.0069|+0.0023|Yes|

### Performance Results — ISL/OSL 1024/1024 (AITER MoE / Relu2 CK-Tile path enabled, VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1)

Model: `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16`, quantization=mxfp4, TP=8
Benchmark: `vllm bench serve`, 256 prompts, dataset=random, input_len=1024, output_len=1024

**Server config:**
```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16 \
  --quantization mxfp4 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --port 8000
```

**Benchmark command:**
```bash
vllm bench serve \
  --backend vllm \
  --base-url http://localhost:8000 \
  --model nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16 \
  --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 1024 \
  --random-output-len 1024 \
  --max-concurrency <1|8|32|64|128> \
  --num-prompts 256 \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el \
  --metric-percentiles 50,99 \
  --save-result
```

|Concurrency|TTFT mean (ms)|TTFT p99 (ms)|TPOT mean (ms)|TPOT p99 (ms)|Output throughput (tok/s)|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|109.22|113.61|12.69|12.74|78.21|
|8|309.58|363.16|13.99|14.35|560.35|
|32|745.24|1073.98|17.27|17.94|1779.22|
|64|1103.88|2068.60|22.12|22.96|2760.03|
|128|1882.44|4172.49|28.08|29.51|4276.63|

All 256/256 requests succeeded at every concurrency level (0 failures).

---

### Performance Results — ISL/OSL 8192/1024 (AITER MoE / Relu2 CK-Tile path enabled, VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1)

Model: `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16`, quantization=mxfp4, TP=8
Benchmark: `vllm bench serve`, 256 prompts, dataset=random, input_len=8192, output_len=1024

Server config and benchmark command identical to above, with `--random-input-len 8192`.

|Concurrency|TTFT mean (ms)|TTFT p99 (ms)|TPOT mean (ms)|TPOT p99 (ms)|Output throughput (tok/s)|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|313.96|317.47|23.68|23.72|41.73|
|8|506.22|637.86|24.80|25.35|316.59|
|32|1099.30|2124.96|28.50|29.50|1082.64|
|64|1675.91|4485.66|34.11|35.33|1790.31|
|128|3158.37|8862.80|41.70|44.32|2853.00|

All 256/256 requests succeeded at every concurrency level (0 failures).

---

### Baseline — ISL/OSL 1024/1024 (mxfp4 without this PR: falls back to `OCP_MXQuantizationEmulationTritonExperts`, VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0)

Model: `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16`, quantization=mxfp4, TP=8
Benchmark: `vllm bench serve`, 256 prompts, dataset=random, input_len=1024, output_len=1024

**Server config:**
```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0
vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16 \
  --quantization mxfp4 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --port 8000
```

**Benchmark command:**
```bash
vllm bench serve \
  --backend vllm \
  --base-url http://localhost:8000 \
  --model nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16 \
  --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len <1024|8192> \
  --random-output-len 1024 \
  --max-concurrency <1|8|32|64|128> \
  --num-prompts 256 \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el \
  --metric-percentiles 50,99 \
  --result-dir /tmp/traces/results/perf_baseline \
  --result-filename isl<ISL>_osl<OSL>_conc<CONC>.json \
  --save-result
```

|Concurrency|TTFT mean (ms)|TTFT p99 (ms)|TPOT mean (ms)|TPOT p99 (ms)|Output throughput (tok/s)|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|172.64|161.14|78.05|78.12|12.80|
|8|570.09|757.64|83.50|84.60|95.27|
|32|1200.49|1643.85|92.74|94.57|341.01|
|64|1738.34|3145.44|101.58|103.27|619.93|
|128|2700.34|6231.50|111.65|113.48|1119.06|

All 256/256 requests succeeded at every concurrency level (0 failures).

### Comparison — ISL/OSL 1024/1024: Baseline (emulation) vs With PR (AITER Relu2 CK-Tile)

|Concurrency|TPOT mean baseline (ms)|TPOT mean with PR (ms)|TPOT speedup|Throughput baseline (tok/s)|Throughput with PR (tok/s)|Throughput speedup|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|78.05|12.69|6.15x|12.80|78.21|6.11x|
|8|83.50|13.99|5.97x|95.27|560.35|5.88x|
|32|92.74|17.27|5.37x|341.01|1779.22|5.22x|
|64|101.58|22.12|4.59x|619.93|2760.03|4.45x|
|128|111.65|28.08|3.98x|1119.06|4276.63|3.82x|

**Note:** On 8x AMD Instinct MI350 (gfx950), TP=8, mxfp4 without this PR falls back to vLLM's `OCP_MXQuantizationEmulationTritonExperts` backend, which dequantizes weights on the fly for every MoE forward pass (vLLM itself logs this as a known-slower path — see `ocp_mx_emulation_moe.py:97`). This PR enables AITER's native CK-Tile Relu2 kernel to operate directly on mxfp4 without dequantization. The speedup is largest at low concurrency (where per-request decode cost isn't amortized across a batch) and narrows  but does not disappear,  as concurrency increases and GPU-side batching absorbs more of the per-token emulation overhead.

@@ -965,6 +965,171 @@ def test_mxfp4_experts_check_accepts_aiter_deployments(
         _validate_mxfp4_experts_config(experts_cls, moe_config, mxfp4_backend)
 
 
+def test_aiter_no_act_and_mul_support_is_mxfp4_only():
+    """Guard against re-broadening non-gated (relu2) support to fp8/bf16
+    AiterExperts."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.rocm_aiter_moe import (
+        AiterExperts,
+        AiterFp8BlockExperts,
+        AiterFp8ChannelExperts,
+        AiterFp8TensorExperts,
+        AiterMxfp4Experts,
+        AiterUnquantizedExperts,
+    )
+
+    assert AiterMxfp4Experts._supports_no_act_and_mul() is True
+
+    for cls in (
+        AiterExperts,
+        AiterUnquantizedExperts,
+        AiterFp8BlockExperts,
+        AiterFp8TensorExperts,
+        AiterFp8ChannelExperts,
+    ):
+        assert cls._supports_no_act_and_mul() is False, (
+            f"{cls.__name__} must not claim non-gated activation support "
+            "until its CK-Tile relu2 kernel path is implemented and verified."
+        )
+
+

